mentions.title: King bearings
mentions.snippet: Thread reporting bearing delamination with King bearings in high-horsepower applications, including a high-boost engine said to be giving off bearing material in the oil, which the poster says stopped after switching brands.

mentions.title: WARNING about King Main Thrust Bearings
mentions.snippet: Explicit buyer-warning thread: King main thrust bearings produced since 2024 reported out of spec, slipping into the cap and block groove without proper interference fit, with a stated risk of spinning the thrust main. Poster says King technical staff confirmed the parts should not be used.
mentions.replyNote: Read successfully: no King or official reply, thread still open and unresolved, most recent post still 3 June 2026 where the poster reports in-spec measurements on replacement thrust bearings.

mentions.title: WARNING!! Check all KING brand bearings before install
mentions.snippet: Buyer-warning thread reporting 0.25 oversize bearings packed in boxes labelled and stamped standard, mixed in with correct standard shells. Poster urges everyone to measure every King bearing before installation.

mentions.title: King Main Bearings Defective
mentions.snippet: Builder reports King STDX thrust bearings for the BMW S85 measuring over 1mm too narrow to fit the block, consistent across multiple blocks, and advises against King main bearings for S85/S65 on the grounds that a dimensional error this basic undermines trust in the brand.

mentions.title: King Bearing - lack of professional help for quality control problem
mentions.snippet: Complaint about King XP series main and rod bearings supplied in an unopened package containing the wrong sizes, compounded by a complaint about the support response. A second poster reports two cases out of roughly 1,000 rebuilds where shells boxed and stamped .50mm measured .75mm.

mentions.title: Got a set of King SI bearings with a defective bearing...awesome
mentions.snippet: Buyer received a King SI main bearing shell malformed in production, crushed and twisted so it would not seat in the block, and reports bearing shaving material and oil inside the shrink wrap of the rod bearing set.
